title: 第二十三章 要出大货了第二十四章 太弱了还得练啊
content_zh:
“终于...化劲了。”
林夜长舒出一口气，眼神中闪烁着道道寒芒。
他能够清楚地感觉到自己已经完全上升了一个大台阶。
不仅仅是力量，还有感官。
他可以听到数公里外的声音，他可以分辨出空气中的不同种气味，并判断出气味来源地，他的视线更是可以看到远处小山头上的鸟儿展翅动作。
“超人类？”
林夜将剩下几瓶没有用的能量药剂收入口袋，来到窗户边上，微微抬腿。
砰——！
轰隆隆...
二四宽的墙体被他一脚踹爆，半边墙体都随之塌裂，而林夜的腿上却连一丝灰尘都没有沾染。
他看着自己的裤子，想起某些事情，似是感觉有些好笑。
“以前看电视，总觉得武林高手对打，为什么不会把衣服裤子炸烂。
现在才明白，对劲力掌握到一定层次，隔山打牛亦如吃饭喝水一样简单。”
他朝下面扫了一眼，这里是六楼，三米的层高，足足有十五米多，林夜略微一跳，身子却不像正常人那样降落，而是像一张纸一样，缓缓降落，完全违背了重力定律。
“化劲可以凭借和空气中的摩擦，抵消一部分重力速度。”
他尝试了一下奔跑，脚下轻点，身子瞬间蹿出百米开外，快到空气中只留下一道残影。
“基础速度提升了三倍多...如果是利用劲力改变空气流动方向呢？”
林夜再次移动，通过锐化前方劲力，破开部分空气阻力，身子比刚才的速度更快，大概增加了十米距离。
“我没有学过空气动力学，之后学习一下，应该还能提升的更快。”
接下来就是力量测试。

他来到刚刚那栋楼房前，深呼吸一口气，开始运转体内劲力，其体表开始微微泛红，血液流动速度加快，肌肉膨胀，体表虬筋如龙。
“喝——！”
轰——！
雷霆一拳轰出，因为速度太快，空气中甚至可以明显看到一丝丝电火花闪过。
一拳轰在墙壁上，瞬间轰出一个五六平方的大窟窿，继而导致整个墙体四分五裂，向上蔓延，直至全部崩塌。
轰隆隆...
林夜没有躲闪，任凭那巨大的墙体砸在自己身上。
砰——！
伴随一声巨响，墙体并未对林夜造成任何伤害，反而好像撞到了一个钢柱上，被反冲力无情撕裂。
“基础力量大幅度提升，在强大的速度加持下，能爆发出基于自身九倍的力量。
攻击具有穿透性，且能化开能量方向的特质。
另外...”
他看了看自己的拳头。
“我的肉身强度也已经达到了全新层次，骨骼、肌肉...应该可以正面硬刚钢筋棍而不虚。
如果加上化劲的话，子弹亦无可奈何。”
化劲宗师，竟恐怖如斯。
这简直就是行走的祖国人，大部分基础热武器都已经无法对自己造成伤害。
子弹再快，开枪的也是人，也需要距离来传递。
content_en:
"Finally... got better."
Lin Ye let out a long breath, his eyes flashing with coldness.
He could clearly feel that he had completely risen to a big level.
Not just the power, but the senses.
He could hear sounds several kilometers away, he could distinguish different smells in the air and determine where the smells came from, and he could even see birds spreading their wings on the hills in the distance.
"Superhuman?"
Lin Ye put the remaining bottles of useless energy potion into his pocket, came to the window, and raised his legs slightly.
Bang--!
Rumble...
The 24-meter-wide wall was kicked open by him, and half of the wall collapsed, but Lin Ye's legs were not stained with even a trace of dust.
He looked at his pants and thought of something, which seemed a little funny.
“When I watched TV before, I always thought why martial arts masters wouldn’t blow up their clothes and pants when they fought.
Only now do I understand that once you have mastered your strength to a certain level, hunting cattle across mountains is as easy as eating and drinking water. "
He glanced down. This was the sixth floor. It was three meters high, more than fifteen meters high. Lin Ye jumped slightly, but his body did not fall like a normal person. Instead, he landed slowly like a piece of paper, completely violating the law of gravity.
"Hua Jin can offset part of the gravitational speed by relying on friction with the air."
He tried running, tapped his feet lightly, and instantly jumped a hundred meters away, so fast that only an afterimage was left in the air.
"The base speed has increased by more than three times... What if force is used to change the direction of air flow?"
Lin Ye moved again, by sharpening the force in front and breaking through part of the air resistance. His body was faster than before, and he increased the distance by about ten meters.
"I haven't studied aerodynamics. If I study it later, I should be able to improve faster."
Next comes the strength test.
He came to the building just now, took a deep breath, and began to use the energy in his body. His body surface began to turn slightly red, his blood flow accelerated, his muscles swelled, and his body surface became muscled like a dragon.
"Drink-!"
Boom——!
Thunder punched out, because the speed was so fast that a trace of electric sparks could be clearly seen flashing in the air.
A punch hit the wall, instantly creating a large hole of five to six square meters, which then caused the entire wall to fall apart and spread upward until it completely collapsed.
Rumble...
Lin Ye did not dodge and allowed the huge wall to hit him.
Bang--!
With a loud noise, the wall did not cause any damage to Lin Ye. Instead, it seemed that it hit a steel column and was ruthlessly torn apart by the recoil force.
"The basic strength has been greatly improved, and with the powerful speed, it can explode nine times its own strength.
The attack is penetrating and can deflect energy directions.
Also..."
He looked at his fist.
"My physical strength has also reached a new level. My bones and muscles... should be able to hit a steel rod head-on without weakening.
If you add Huajin, the bullets will be helpless. "
Grandmaster Huajin is so terrifying.
This is simply a walking motherland, and most basic thermal weapons are no longer able to cause harm to themselves.
No matter how fast the bullet is, the person who shoots it still needs distance to transmit it.
